plain.text: "Answer me when I call, my righteous God! You gave me relief when I was in distress. Have mercy on me and hear my prayer." David asks how long people will turn his honour into shame and love what is false. He knows the LORD has set apart the faithful for himself and hears when he calls.
"Be angry, yet do not sin. On your bed, search your heart and be still." Offer right sacrifices and trust in the LORD.

Many people ask, "Who will show us anything good?" David prays, "Let the light of your face shine on us, LORD." God has filled his heart with more joy than people have when their harvest of grain and wine is plentiful. "I will lie down and sleep in peace, for you alone, LORD, make me dwell in safety."

summary.bigIdea: God's presence gives a deeper joy and peace than plenty of good things can.
points: David asks God to answer his prayer in distress.
He urges people to be still and reflect instead of sinning in anger.
God's joy is greater than a big harvest, and he gives peaceful sleep.
summary.reflection: David found more joy in God than in having plenty. What gives you real joy?
